8.37.3. iLock_Geography.switch_types.crossNodes2DSDX¶

iLock_Geography.switch_types.crossNodes2DSDX(railyard, crossingType, locked)¶

Returns a copy of the railyard where some crossnodes are altered to DSDX nodes.

The crossNodes are pointed out by pointer objects (signalObjects of subtype ‘GDSDX_POINTER’) and are found by searching in the direction of each pointer object until a node of degree 4 is found (see getPointedNodeIndices).

Parameters:
  • railyard (IRailyard) – The railyard from which the new railyard is generated.
  • crossingType (str) – Subtype of the genericInside objects, in the crossingNodes, that should be altered to DSDX_TYPE.
  • locked (bool) – If true the returned railyard will be locked; if false the returned railyard is a MutableRailyard (hence not locked).
Return type:

IRailyard | MutableRailyard
Returns:

Copy of the railyard where some crossNodes, pointed out by the objects of subtype GDSDX_POINTER, have been changed to new nodes of type DSDX.
